name: ManyChat
tagline: The reference for Instagram and WhatsApp automation
description: Automation platform for Instagram, WhatsApp and Messenger, with comment triggers, visual flows and sales tools that run inside the DM.
priceNote: Pricing as of October 2026; plans change — check the official site.
bestFor: Anyone selling and supporting on Instagram and WhatsApp, at high volume
pros: The Instagram comment trigger is the trick that turns a post into an automatic sale
Connects straight to the WhatsApp Business API with a real conversation, not a mass broadcast
Visual flows with buttons, carousels, forms and menus, built without writing code
Open, reply and click reports that help measure what the flow returns
cons: Works only on Meta's channels, and a number blocked or restricted by the platform takes everything down
Per-contact billing grows fast and the price scales with the size of the active contact base
Meta's policies change often and a flow can break without warning
Integrates well with Instagram, but deep ERP integration is left to you

features.name: Instagram triggers
features.detail: Comments, keywords, mentions and DMs launch the flow automatically

features.name: Native WhatsApp
features.detail: Connects to the official API and keeps the conversation inside WhatsApp Business

features.name: Visual flow editor
features.detail: Message, button, carousel, menu and delay blocks, with no code

features.name: Sales tools
features.detail: Catalog, coupon, payment link and cart recovery inside the chat

features.name: A/B testing and reports
features.detail: Compares flow versions and shows opens, replies and conversions

useCases: Reply to a post comment with a coupon link and close the sale over WhatsApp
Recover a customer who abandoned the cart in the online store with an automatic message
Confirm a clinic appointment and send a reminder with address and documents
Segment the base by tag and trigger a nurture sequence for a warm lead
bestForWho: Companies running direct marketing on Instagram and WhatsApp, with a sales team answering conversations all day.
verdict: ManyChat remains the sharpest tool for anyone selling inside Instagram and WhatsApp, and the comment trigger is still the cheapest sales mechanism on the market. The platform's risk is not price, it is dependency: when Meta changes a messaging rule or restricts an account, the operation stops and the sales team is left without a channel. The other point is the per-contact billing model, which gets more expensive as the base grows and is usually the item that surprises people most on the invoice. For a small company, the Pro plan with your current contact base is enough and the payback comes fast. For a larger company, plan a multichannel migration and do not put the whole operation on a single Meta platform.
